description: DB integration: the transaction-aware primitive inserts a missing tenant_settings row and stores the supplied onboarding patch through the migrated schema
DB integration: patching existing onboarding_data preserves unrelated fields, replaces matching top-level fields, handles null stored data, and omits undefined patch properties
DB integration concurrency: two independent connections apply different onboarding patches concurrently and both fields survive without a lost update
DB integration rollback guard: a progress patch made through a transaction is absent after that transaction is deliberately rolled back

DB-backed ticketing regression: with a valid support email and transaction-local lock_timeout at or below 8 seconds, configureTicketing uses the real progress writer, completes without 55P03, and commits settings.supportEmail plus all ticketing progress fields
DB-backed ticketing guard: blank or invalid support email does not overwrite an existing supportEmail, while the valid non-email ticketing progress patch still commits

Onboarding action contract/integration: every transaction-wrapped tenant-details, team-members, billing, and ticketing progress write receives the active trx and no transaction callback invokes the public progress action
Wizard unit: deferred step-position promises prove saves execute serially and preserve step-change order even when an earlier request resolves slowly
Wizard unit: rejecting one queued step-position save logs the error, permits the next queued save, and does not block navigation
Wizard unit: Finish does not call validation, configureTicketing, or completeOnboarding until the pending step-position queue settles
Wizard unit failure guard: Finish continues through ticketing and completion after a pending position save rejects, and no late position request runs after completion

Manual appliance smoke: on a fresh appliance installation, enter a valid support email, finish onboarding, refresh, and verify onboarding remains complete with the support email available in settings and no 55P03 in the application logs
